title: Normalized native sheaf projection formula in both orders
statement: Let k₀, ℓ and j:U→Z be as in [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Use the actual sheaf tensor bifunctors of [def-sf-native-open-tensor-operations]. Fix an extension/restriction adjunction whose unit and counit forget to the ordinary specified open unit and counit, and fix pointwise normalized restriction/tensor comparisons as in [lem-sf-native-open-restriction-tensor]. For each M on U and N on Z there is an isomorphism Γ(M,N):(j!M)⊗N ≅ j!(M⊗j*N) whose inverse, under this adjunction, is tensoring its unit with j*N followed by inverse restriction/tensor comparison. There also exist natural isomorphisms (M,N)↦(j!M)⊗N ≅ (M,N)↦j!(M⊗j*N), and (N,M)↦N⊗(j!M) ≅ (N,M)↦j!(j*N⊗M). The natural isomorphisms are not required to be identified with Γ. All three comparisons are on the sheaf categories alone. No complex, totalization or K-flatness statement is included.

proof.text: Frobenius reindexes the same factoring objects on both sides of the generator formula, hence these maps commute with the Weil structures. Faithful forgetting lifts their inverse identities. Transpose the inverse through the normalized adjunction; the generator formula for the unit and the normalized restriction comparison give the specified equality.

lean.statement:
theorem native_open_sheaf_projection_tensor
    (adj : extensionByZero k₀ l j ⊣ upperStar k₀ l j)
    (hu : ∀ M, (adj.unit.app M).hom.f =
      (ProEtale.adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction l
        (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).unit.app M.carrier)
    (hc : ∀ N, (adj.counit.app N).hom.f =
      (ProEtale.adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction l
        (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).counit.app N.carrier)
    (rho : ∀ M N : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z,
      (upperStar k₀ l j).obj (tensor k₀ l Z N M) ≅
        tensor k₀ l U ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj N) ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj M))
    (hrho : ∀ M N, HEq ((rho M N).hom.hom.f)
      ((ProEtale.adicUpperStarTensorLeftIso l
        (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _)) N.carrier).hom.app M.carrier)) :
    ∃ gamma : ∀ (M : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l U) (N : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z),
      tensor k₀ l Z N ((extensionByZero k₀ l j).obj M) ≅
        (extensionByZero k₀ l j).obj (tensor k₀ l U ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj N) M),
      (∀ M N, HEq (adj.homEquiv _ _ ((gamma M N).inv))
        ((tensorFunctor k₀ l U ((upperStar k₀ l j).obj N)).map (adj.unit.app M) ≫
          (rho ((extensionByZero k₀ l j).obj M) N).inv)) ∧
      Nonempty (nativeOpenSheafLeft k₀ l j ≅ nativeOpenSheafRight k₀ l j) ∧
      Nonempty ((𝟭 (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z)).prod (extensionByZero k₀ l j) ⋙
          nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l Z ≅
        (upperStar k₀ l j).prod (𝟭 (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l U)) ⋙ nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l U ⋙
          extensionByZero k₀ l j)
